notes.title: Dev Update #2
notes.content:
Hey all ːsteamhappyː

Long time no see but don't worry I have been working on game for the whole time (I mean in my free time capacity - which is not a lot 😊)

Technical update

I would like to start this update with sharing with you a massive milestone in project. Rug Cleaning Simulator surpassed 1000 commits to repository. This means that I've added 1000 minor or major updates to game from start of project. To be true I don't track time spend on project but for sure it already took me more than 1000 work hours ːsteamhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980381/13e25c13da60cfe34b29ce7df263d307e6082c45.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980381/d78a75e2a296d03670c6c2136390dcc248eb6953.png

as you can see on screenshot of my repository, I'm working on game almost every day. I'm trying to work on game everyday even if it's small bug fix, update or new functionality.


What's new?

Ok, enough about technical/project stuff and let me update you on game.

First and most important part in this update is Game User Interface (GUI). I was creating most of things from scratch as before I didn't have almost any UI in game. Before I was focusing on gameplay and now most time I spend on menus, character updates screen, settings etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980381/2540701d4feacf97834d678184d7c14a1af7ea99.gif


Character progression system. When player gets level up, he will grand some rewards (tool skins etc.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980381/88f8322fc4011e796770fd457d8167c386465f4c.png


Cleaning time!
As this is not finished mechanics - it lack VFXs, some physics, particles and other adjustments, core system already works. By saying core system I mean mechanics that makes all cleaning types important to get clean rug well done. Basically if some part of rug won't be cleaned by rotary scrubber then next phase water extraction don't make that part of rug cleaned as it could be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980381/e5c194668414b00bdf492464b408ff9464c16a20.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980381/aa3b5cbfa42015e4bd6560dc78325b7ecf3c6fb2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980381/7fa03b0a13131ce1142e2a74cf2f6652819695cd.png

What next?

Things that's are done:
- Main menu, Settings menu (Audio, Video settings needs some adjustments). Need to add Gameplay settings screen but this will be easy now as I already have system for that
- Preloading shaders and loading screens. I've created system that loads main gameplay scene when player is launching game so basically loading screen will be much shorter during gameplay
- Moved all current mechanics to main game scene (beach)
- Almost full game loop is more or less working (clients and coming to shop with unique rugs, we talk with them, get their rugs, clean them and return cleaned)

To do list:
- Complete game loop. Need to create progression and reward system base on our rug cleaning quality
- Add more dirt and rugs variants (for now I've got just few for testing purposes)
- Shop customisation
- Tool upgrade system, tool skins selection
- Rug discovery menu with progression system
- Steam Cloud save, achievements etc.



When Demo?
My current goal is to prepare game demo in 2 months. After demo being published, I'll open discord and talk with you about suggested changes and opinions and fix those things before full game release.

 I'll be posting more stuff on game and demo here.

notes.title: Dev Update #1
notes.content:
Hey all ːsteamhappyː

First of all, let me say that despite the fact that I publish this news during the period of All Saints/Halloween, the game is still alive 😊

As I'm solo developer doing almost all stuff alone (except 3D models I buy or music I commissioned to be created) my time is very limited (not speaking about day to day job and family). What I wanted to say is that I strongly limited for now marketing, or status updates of game in favor of working on game itself.

I'm trying to do something in the game almost every day (even small things). I believe I've finished the hardest part of game mechanics and now I'm focusing on connecting all things together.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980381/58282e37bd1abdfd73e341d219ab6bc0177461d7.png

Things that are done:
- Cleaning rugs with updating rug textures (depending on rug cleaning stage (watering, rotary cleaning etc.)
- Saving & Loading game with keeping rug statuses (basically you can save game in the middle of cleaning rug and on load you will start with rug being cleaning as you left it) <- that was huge pain ːsteamsadː
- NPC system - I can now easily generate NPCs with random/custom visuals and jobs they have to do. Main goal is to create immersive NPCs you can as a player interact with (but we will see where it will go)
- Steam Deck build - I was able to run game on Steam deck! Steam deck support, green tick is my goal
- Time & Day system - for now it's basic but works fine with day/night cycle
- Testing Settings menu etc. 
- FSR2 support (I bumped up Godot engine for that sweet feature). Game now works more smooth.
- Game environment - industrial part of big city (that will make more sense than random beach as it was in first trailer)


To do list:
- Finishing main game loop. NPC will bring dirty rugs, we will clean rugs and earn money, respect and exp.
- gamification (rare rugs, collecting all rugs knowledge or something like this etc.)
- Menus, UI/GUI
- Character creator (not sure if this is big priority now - please let me know)
- Shop customisation
- Minor bug fixes (cars rides weirdly after collision etc.)

When Demo?
My current goal is to have demo being done in 3 - 6 months. After demo being published, I'll open discord and talk with you about suggested changes and opinions and fix those things before full game release.

 I'll be posting more stuff on game and demo here.
